portal_hypertension.title: Prognostic Performance of Phosphatidylethanol With Noninvasive Liver Fibrosis Tests in Alcohol-Related Liver Disease.
portal_hypertension.authors: Torp N, Johansen S, Jensen EL
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：我们研究了 PEth 与无创肝纤维化测试 (NIT) 的预后性能，以预测酒精相关肝病 (ALD) 高危人群的肝功能失代偿。 临床提示：酒精是肝脏相关死亡率的一个关键驱动因素，而磷脂酰乙醇 (PEth) 是酒精摄入量的直接生物标志物。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Alcohol is a key driver of liver-related mortality, and phosphatidylethanol (PEth) is a direct biomarker of alcohol intake. We investigated the prognostic performance of PEth with noninvasive liver fibrosis tests (NITs) for predicting hepatic decompensation in an alcohol-related liver disease (ALD) at-risk population. Prospective cohort study with 411 at risk of ALD without prior known chronic liver disease of whom 162 had a follow-up PEth. PEth was measured from whole blood by liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry. portal_hypertension.title: Prevalence and Clinical Outcomes of Recompensation in Decompensated Cirrhosis: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
portal_hypertension.journal: Clinical gastroenterology and hepatology : the official clinical practice journal of the American Gastroenterological Association
portal_hypertension.authors: Goh XE, Goh MX, Chen VL
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究（样本量约为 9063）。核心观点：失代偿性肝硬化患者的再代偿发生率和临床结果仍不清楚。 临床提示：我们的目的是确定实现再代偿的失代偿患者的患病率和临床结果。
portal_hypertension.abstract: The prevalence and clinical outcomes of recompensation in patients with decompensated cirrhosis remain unclear. We aimed to determine the prevalence and clinical outcomes among decompensated patients who achieve recompensation. We systematically searched PubMed and EMBASE from inception until July 15, 2025. We included studies reporting on decompensated cirrhosis patients achieving recompensation to evaluate the clinical outcomes, specifically hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), death, liver-related death, and liver transplantation, with those who did not recompensate. portal_hypertension.title: Hepatic histoplasmosis presenting as portal hypertension in an immunocompetent elderly male: A multidisciplinary case report.
portal_hypertension.authors: Jyoti D, Singh P, Ghotekar LH
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：组织胞浆菌病由荚膜组织胞浆菌引起，是一种二形性真菌，通常流行于美洲、非洲和亚洲部分地区。 临床提示：吸入暴露主要导致肺部感染，肺外或孤立的肝脏感染很少见，特别是在免疫功能正常的个体中。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Histoplasmosis, caused by Histoplasma capsulatum , is a dimorphic fungus typically endemic to parts of the Americas, Africa, and Asia. Inhalational exposure leads primarily to pulmonary infection, and extrapulmonary or isolated hepatic presentations are rare, particularly in immuno-competent individuals. We present an unusual case of hepatic histoplasmosis with no evident lung involvement, highlighting a diagnostic challenge and a rewarding pathologic discovery.
